methods: All original audio/marks extracted from exact current frozen native bundle, no resynthesis of original.
Whole actual native utterances independent unprompted multilingual ASR; lexical numbers and names only, not tone proof.
Finite 28 current full-card control MP3s with all target substitutions disclosed, target MFCC/F0 and independently calibrated two-sided LOO.
One bounded localization pass reuses those same28 controls; no expanding acoustic search.
limitations: Controls change multiple target letters in same utterance and can alter neighbouring phonemes/prosody.
Some positive homophones are contextual or rare; real reference selftest can fail. Actual uncertain/unreliable positions remain pending.
The first-round intended-vs-other contrast does not exhaust every rare dictionary pronunciation.
No human listening performed or claimed.
No source/final loudness/RMS/peak/silence/gain/PCM checks; pronunciation features omit MFCC C0 and RMS calculation entirely.
